 Order

The Criminal Original Petition has been filed to quash the proceedings in S.C.No.29 of 2023 on the file of the Mahila Sessions Court, Thoothukudi for the offence punishable under Sections 294(b),
376, 406, 417, 506(2) and 324 IPC.
2.The case is still at the stage of trial.
By passage of time, the parties have decided to bury their hatchet and compromise the dispute amicably among themselves.
It is also submitted that the defacto complainant does not want to proceed the case further.
To that effect, a Joint Memo of Compromise signed by the petitioner and the second respondent and also by their respective counsel has also been filed before this Court and the same is recorded.
3.The petitioner and the second respondent were also present in person before this Court and they were identified by the concerned Police Official.
This Court also enquired both the parties and was satisfied that the parties have come to an amicable settlement between themselves.

https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis 4.Under such circumstances, no useful purpose will be served in keeping the proceedings pending,
even though, the offences involved are not compoundable in nature.

In the light of the guidelines given by the Hon'ble Supreme Court reported in 2017 9 SCC 641-(Parbathbhai Aahir @ Parbathbhai Vs. State of Gujrath), this Court in exercise of its jurisdiction under Section 482 Cr.P.C. quashes the case in S.C.No.29 of 2023 pending on the file of the Mahila Sessions Court, Thoothukudi.
